model_kind: Editable native external dimensional reconstruction; not OEM CAD
datum: PCB seating underside of flange Z=0, contact along +Z, tail along -Z
compression_parameter: part.Parameters.Compression; independent sibling parameter object avoids a child-to-parent expression cycle

sources.relevant_page: 1 for exact MPN, initial height and stroke; 2 for general tolerances

drawing_unit: inch; mm calculated with exact 25.4 multiplier

stroke_resolution.warning: The .039 callout belongs to the short-stroke variants, not selected 0906-2. Do not substitute it for selected stroke.

model_detail_limits: Round plunger top and tail end are represented as hemispheres inferred from the drawing. Their radii are not separately dimensioned by the manufacturer.
Undimensioned chamfers, edge breaks, internal spring and internal working clearances are omitted.
Plunger body represents its external projection only; Compression changes exposed stem length. This is not a spring/force simulation.
Nominal 0.6 mm compression is an assembly setting below catalog midstroke 0.6985 mm; acceptance of the finished tolerance stack remains a separate check.
Manufacturer general tolerances do not establish installed coplanarity or force. Actual received pins and the finished mounting/stop stack need measurement.
